name: Tekton Load Combination
description: Load combinations, generated or by hand. With 'generate' on, the EN 1990 combinations for the wired load cases are built: ULS 6.10 with every variable action leading once and the others entering by psi_0, plus SLS characteristic (6.14b) and quasi-permanent (6.16b) for deflection and creep. The psi factors come from the action category on each load case. Without 'generate', give factors parallel to load_cases and it builds that one combination. The factors are EN 1990 recommended values, NOT checked by an engineer and not a national annex - see docs/discussion/work-packages.md.

inputParameters.name: name
inputParameters.description: Name, e.g. 'ULS 1'. Only for a manual combination; generated ones name themselves.

inputParameters.name: factors
inputParameters.description: Factors, parallel to load_cases. Ignored when 'generate' is on.

inputParameters.name: combination_type
inputParameters.description: ULS | SLS, for a manual combination. Default ULS.

inputParameters.name: generate
inputParameters.description: Build the EN 1990 combinations from the load cases' action categories instead of taking 'factors'.

inputParameters.name: favourable
inputParameters.description: Treat permanent actions as favourable (gamma_G = 1.0). For uplift, where self-weight helps and must not be inflated.

outputParameters.name: report
outputParameters.description: What was generated, with the clause each combination came from
